dtsPropsFor.ActiveNowView:
devices: { id: string; name: string; /** room name, null = no room */ room: string | null; /** e.g. "Heaters", "Sockets" */ type: string; isConnected: boolean; isEnabled: boolean | null; /** watts */ power: number; /** power is estimated (e.g. Hue), shown with ≈ */ estimated?: boolean }[];
